managementFootnotes.fact: Stage lengths are regional and planting-period examples. Variety, weather and management can change them.
managementFootnotes.implementation: Every profile carries a stage-example assumption.

managementFootnotes.fact: Crucifers include cabbage, cauliflower, broccoli and Brussels sprouts.
managementFootnotes.implementation: Four crop purposes share the April Mediterranean row with an explicit warning.

managementFootnotes.fact: Winter-wheat initial/development periods lengthen with frozen-soil dormancy.
managementFootnotes.implementation: Winter-wheat Kc uses the non-frozen-soil assumption. Full geographic enforcement is outside this slice.

managementFootnotes.fact: Sweet-maize late stage is about 35 days when grain matures and dries.
managementFootnotes.implementation: Sweet-maize profiles use fresh harvest and 10-day late stages. Idaho typography and printed total remain unresolved.

managementFootnotes.fact: Initial Kc depends on wetting and evaporation. Frequent wetting can raise it toward 1.0-1.2.
managementFootnotes.implementation: General initial values are qualified in each non-rice profile.

managementFootnotes.fact: Stalks of 1.5-2 m call for increased Kc. Examples give 1.15 for green beans/peppers/cucumbers and 1.20 for tomatoes/dry beans/peas.
managementFootnotes.implementation: Explicit non-stalk assumptions cover beans, peas, peppers and tomatoes. Faba dry omits this qualification.

managementFootnotes.fact: Long-season potato with vine kill has end Kc about 0.40.
managementFootnotes.implementation: Potato selects 0.75 and explicitly excludes the vine-kill assumption.

managementFootnotes.fact: Green gram/cowpea end values are 0.60 fresh and 0.35 dry.
managementFootnotes.implementation: Both dry-grain profiles select 0.35 with the harvest condition recorded.

managementFootnotes.fact: Lower oil-crop midseason values correspond to rainfed, less-dense stands.
managementFootnotes.implementation: Sunflower/safflower select 1.0 from 1.0-1.15 and state both conditions.

managementFootnotes.fact: Higher wheat end coefficient 0.4 is for hand harvest.
managementFootnotes.implementation: Wheat selects 0.25 with an explicit machine-harvest assumption.

managementFootnotes.fact: Field-maize end coefficients are 0.60 at high grain moisture and 0.35 after field drying near 18 percent wet-basis moisture.
managementFootnotes.implementation: Grain maize selects 0.35 and states complete field drying.

managementFootnotes.fact: Sweet-maize end Kc 1.05 applies to fresh human-consumption harvest.
managementFootnotes.implementation: Sweet maize explicitly uses fresh harvest.

managementFootnotes.fact: Rice initial Kc 1.05 assumes 0.10-0.20 m standing water and subhumid calm-to-moderate wind conditions.
managementFootnotes.implementation: Rice records the ponding assumption, 0.90 end-range selection, and excluded ponding/seepage/percolation demand.

managementFootnotes.fact: Coefficients represent non-stressed, well-managed crops under subhumid standard conditions around RHmin 45 percent and 2 m/s wind.
managementFootnotes.implementation: Every profile states these standard conditions and absence of climatic adjustment.

resultLegend.support: Evidence support for checked dimensions only: supported, qualified or discrepancy; not whole-profile agronomic approval.
resultLegend.result: Legacy source-comparison summary: match, unverified or discrepancy. Unverified can be a qualified source interpretation; consult support and exceptional checks.
resultLegend.checks: Only exceptional checks are retained. checkedFields enumerates the dimensions actually compared. Empty checks does not certify unlisted dimensions.
